description: This file contains logic for managing and removing deprecated or unavailable Kubernetes API resources based on versioning, alpha/beta status, and configuration flags. It defines classes and functions for evaluating resource expiration, removing outdated kinds, and handling version-specific API serving logic.

classes.name: resourceExpirationEvaluator
classes.description: Class responsible for evaluating whether resources should be served or removed based on versioning and alpha/beta status.

methods.name: isNotRemoved
methods.description: Checks if a resource is not marked as removed based on its version and removal info.

methods.name: ShouldServeForVersion
methods.description: Determines if a resource should be served based on its removal version compared to current version.

methods.name: removeDeletedKinds
methods.description: Removes resources that have been marked as deleted or are no longer available.

methods.name: RemoveUnavailableKinds
methods.description: Removes unavailable or unintroduced resources based on versioning and configuration.

methods.name: removeUnintroducedKinds
methods.description: Removes resources introduced after the current version.

methods.name: shouldServeBasedOnVersionIntroduced
methods.description: Determines if a resource introduced after the current version should be served, considering emulation flags.
